parameters.name: source
parameters.description: A .mtlx document: a file path when sourceType is documentFile, or inline .mtlx XML text when sourceType is documentInline

parameters.name: sourceType
parameters.description: How `source` is interpreted: documentFile (default, a path) or documentInline (inline .mtlx XML text)

parameters.name: materialName
parameters.description: Optional. Selects a material within the document (see the `materialNames` property). When unset and several exist, the first is used
